conditions.label: Is a vampire
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is a vampire.

conditions.label: Vampire Lord form
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is transformed into a Vampire Lord.

conditions.label: Thirst stage
conditions.description: Triggers while the player vampire's thirst is {param1} ({param2}).

conditions.label: Fed recently
conditions.description: Triggers while the player vampire has fed within the last {param1} hours.

conditions.label: Vampire rank
conditions.description: Triggers while the player vampire's rank is {param1} or higher.

conditions.label: Rank progress
conditions.description: Triggers while the player vampire is at least {param1}% of the way to the next rank.

conditions.label: Hemomancy stage
conditions.description: Triggers while the player has learned at least {param1} stages of Hemomancy.

conditions.label: Wassail
conditions.description: Triggers while the player vampire has at least {param1} Wassail.

conditions.label: Vampire Lord perks
conditions.description: Triggers once the player has earned at least {param1} Vampire Lord perks.

conditions.label: Levitating
conditions.description: Triggers while the player is levitating in Vampire Lord form.

effects.label: Sate thirst
effects.description: When shown, the player vampire's thirst is sated, as if they had just fed.

effects.label: Deepen thirst
effects.description: When shown, the player vampire's thirst worsens by one stage.

effects.label: Grant rank age
effects.description: When shown, the player vampire gains {param1} hours toward their next rank.

effects.label: Quicken aging
effects.description: While shown, the player vampire gains rank age {param1}% faster.

effects.label: Sun ward
effects.description: While shown, the sun does not harm the player vampire.

effects.label: Masquerade ward
effects.description: While shown, being Blood Starved does not turn people hostile to the player.

effects.label: Threshold ward
effects.description: While shown, the player vampire does not suffer the Trespassing Curse.

effects.label: Grant Vampire Lord blood
effects.description: When shown, the player gains {param1} Vampire Lord blood points toward their next perk.
